tail_focus.label: 热门方压力失误
tail_focus.definition_cn: 更被看好的一方在关键轮次罚丢，非热门方点球晋级。

selected_scores.rationale_cn: 原提案3-4是矩阵中摩洛哥胜出的高频常见比分，概率应为0.13710046367851622且不属于tail；为保留“压力失误导致非预期出局”的尾部口径，修正为矩阵中的1-3、摩洛哥胜。该比分合法，代表法国多名罚手失手且摩洛哥在五轮内建立不可追差优势。若无赛前强弱证据，“热门”表述不应作为事实断言，因此标题改为法国压力失误。
selected_scores.rationale_en: The original 3-4 proposal is a high-frequency common B-team win score in the matrix, with probability 0.13710046367851622, and is not in the tail. To keep the tail framing of an unexpected exit caused by pressure errors, it is revised to 1-3, B-team win, in the matrix. This score is valid and represents multiple A-team takers missing while B-team builds an uncatchable lead within five rounds. Without pre-match strength evidence, "favorite" should not be stated as fact, so the title is changed to A-team pressure errors.

penalties.workflow_cn: 点球专属流程：证据整合 → 4个专家Agent → 专家委员会聚合 → 点球序列Rollout → 点球比分矩阵 → 点球Tail审计 → 报告输出。
penalties.condition_en: Condition: the match is level after 90 minutes and remains level after extra time; inputs include the 90-minute prediction, extra-time mini-pipeline results, penalty evidence, goalkeepers, takers and pressure factors.
penalties.workflow_en: Penalty workflow: evidence synthesis → specialist agents → committee aggregation → shootout-sequence rollout → penalty matrix → tail audit → report output. Treat the penalty tab as scenario distribution, not a confident taker-by-taker forecast.

method_en: The v6.3 branch-aware knockout pipeline uses pre-match evidence, specialist-agent reasoning, and conditional Monte Carlo over 90 minutes, extra time, and penalties. For this France vs Morocco run, the evidence layer is complete, but the rollout/committee layer required fallback support, so the frontend should present it as a low-confidence reference rather than a final high-confidence call.
architecture_en: Extra time and penalties are slices of the same conditional path tree rather than separate post-processing outputs. Because this run had elevated rollout fallback, the displayed tail paths should be treated as scenario guidance, not precise game-state simulation.
